<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sp(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']
        r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); r1=max(p[0] for p in bb)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bb); c1=max(p[1] for p in bb)
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']>=2 and r0>=17 and c0>16:
            out.append((n['color'],(r0,r1,c0,c1)))
    return out
def step(a, label):
    r = action([a])
    print(label, sp(history[-1].frame), 'changed:', r.get('board_changed'), 'done:', r.get('done'))
    return r
# 1. shrink
step({'action':'MOUSE','row':60,'col':30}, 'shrink')
# 2. move left to 19-20
step('LEFT','L1'); step('LEFT','L2')
# 3. try DOWN (vertical b-left/S-right orientation)
step('DOWN','D1')
# if still top row, rotate to horizontal and try again
step('UP','rot'); step('DOWN','D2')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
